semantics.function: z is 1 exactly when A equals B; otherwise z is 0
semantics.timing: Purely combinational; output follows current inputs with no clock cycles or registered latency

numeric.inputs: Two unsigned 2-bit vectors, each representing 0 through 3
numeric.arithmetic: Exact equality of both bits; no addition, truncation, rounding, saturation or overflow

verification.plan: Independently enumerate all 16 pairs of input values 0 through 3 and compare output to integer equality after combinational settling
verification.coverage: All four equal pairs and twelve unequal pairs, including minimum and maximum inputs
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite command timeouts
verification.pass_criterion: Every expected-versus-actual comparison passes; explicit PASS marker

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z input bits is unspecified; verification covers binary inputs only.
